services.name: Option 4: Jet Ski or Kayak
services.desc: Experienced riders do run jet skis out to the sandbar, and paddlers occasionally kayak over on calm mornings. Both work only in good conditions and only for people comfortable in open water with boat traffic around them. Storage is nonexistent, so coolers, chairs, and floats stay behind. This is a short-visit option,

explain.meaning: A flat, steady boat on two floats, good for relaxed groups.

services.name: Tiki Boat vs Pontoon Rental
services.desc: Rentals win on price for small groups and on freedom for confident boaters. A half-day pontoon runs roughly $300 to $500 and a full day $500 to $800 in the Destin market. Four to six people splitting that lands at a reasonable per-person

explain.meaning: A flat, steady boat on two floats, good for relaxed groups.

services.name: Rental
services.desc: Fuel gets billed on return and adds $60 to $150 on a full day of running. Florida’s boater safety course costs around $14 and takes a couple hours to complete before your trip, required for anyone born after January 1, 1988. Damage deposits get held against your card. Most rental pontoons carry no bathroom at all,
